description: Call an API that charges per request in NGT on Base (x402). Pays the seller's price only if it is NGT on Base and at or under the cap, then returns the response with the amount paid, the seller wallet and the Base transaction. Use when the user asks for data or an action from an NGT-paywalled URL. Each call spends real NGT; do not call in a loop.

max_price_ngt.description: Most to pay for this call, in NGT. Cannot exceed the server cap of 0.01 NGT.
